214.name: Raging Storm
214.description: Critically striking a foe grants fury. Gain ferocity while under the effects of fury.

221.name: Zephyr's Speed
221.description: Your chance to critically strike is increased. While attuned to air, your movement speed is also increased.

222.name: Electric Discharge
222.description:
Strike your target with a bolt of lightning when attuning to air.
Also triggers on overload skills.

223.name: Aeromancer's Training
223.description: Gain ferocity, and gain additional ferocity while attuned to air. Air weapon skills get a reduced recharge time.

224.name: One with Air
224.description: Gain superspeed when attuning to air.

226.name: Bolt to the Heart
226.description: Deal increased strike damage to enemies below the health threshold.

227.name: Zephyr's Boon
227.description: Grant boons to allies you grant auras to.

229.name: Inscription
229.description: Gain boons upon casting a <c=@abilitytype>glyph</c> based on your attunement. Gain resistance when attuning to air.

232.name: Ferocious Winds
232.description: Gain ferocity based on your precision.

238.name: Evasive Arcana
238.description: Cast a skill when you dodge based on your attunement.

253.name: Arcane Precision
253.description: Your critical strikes have a chance to inflict a condition based on your attunement.

257.name: Final Shielding
257.description: Cast Lesser Arcane Shield when you use an elite skill.

263.name: Arcane Lightning
263.description: <c=@abilitytype>Arcane</c> skills grant increased ferocity and have additional effects.

264.name: Elemental Attunement
264.description:
Grant a boon to nearby allies when changing attunements.
<c=@reminder>Note: This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element.</c>

265.name: Arcane Resurrection
265.description: Cast Geyser when you begin reviving a downed ally. Geyser now partially revives downed allies. When you begin reviving an ally, you gain an aura based on your attunement.

266.name: Renewing Stamina
266.description: Gain vigor when you critically strike a foe.

268.name: Arcane Prowess
268.description: Gain boons when you switch attunements.

275.name: Strength of Stone
275.description:
Gain condition damage based on your toughness. Inflict bleeding when you immobilize a foe.
Bleeding can only occur on the same target once per interval.

277.name: Earthen Blessing
277.description: Decrease the duration of movement-impairing conditions applied to you. Restore endurance when you receive one of these conditions.

278.name: Stone Flesh
278.description: Strike damage taken is reduced while attuned to earth.

279.name: Earthen Blast
279.description:
Gain barrier and cripple nearby foes when attuning to earth.
Also triggers on overload skills. Barrier will not be gained when attuning to the same element.

280.name: Geomancer's Training
280.description: Strike damage from nearby foes is reduced. Earth weapon skills gain reduced recharge.

281.name: Rock Solid
281.description:
Grant stability to nearby allies when attuning to earth.
<c=@reminder>Note: This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element.</c>

282.name: Earth's Embrace
282.description: Gain resistance after using a healing skill.

287.name: Written in Stone
287.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging. Gain an aura when you use a <c=@abilitytype>signet</c> skill.

289.name: Elemental Shielding
289.description: Auras you grant to allies also grant protection.

294.name: Pyromancer's Puissance
294.description: Gain might for using any skill while attuned to fire. When leaving fire attunement or successfully completing a fire overload, unleash a Flame Expulsion.

296.name: Burning Precision
296.description: Burning you inflict has increased duration and your critical hits gain a chance to inflict burning.

318.name: Sunspot
318.description:
Gain a fire aura, and damage nearby foes when you attune to fire.
Also triggers on overload skills.

319.name: Pyromancer's Training
319.description: Your fire-weapon skills gain reduced recharge. Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

320.name: Empowering Flame
320.description: Gain power while in fire attunement.

325.name: Burning Rage
325.description: Sunspot inflicts burning, and its radius is increased. Your condition damage is increased.

328.name: Conjurer
328.description: Gain fire aura when an ally picks up a conjured weapon.

334.name: Power Overwhelming
334.description: While at or above the might threshold, gain increased power. Power bonuses are doubled while attuned to fire.

335.name: Burning Fire
335.description: Cast Lesser Cleansing Fire when you have a number of conditions on you.

340.name: Smothering Auras
340.description: Fire auras have increased duration. Applying auras to allies removes conditions, and transmuting auras removes conditions from nearby allies.

348.name: Soothing Ice
348.description: Gain regeneration and frost aura when you use a healing skill.

349.name: Flow like Water
349.description: Deal increased strike damage, which is further increased while your health is above the threshold. Blocking or evading an attack heals you.

350.name: Soothing Mist
350.description: You and nearby allies recover health while you are attuned to water.

351.name: Healing Ripple
351.description:
Heal nearby allies when attuning to water.
This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element, but will be triggered by overload skills.

358.name: Cleansing Wave
358.description: Remove conditions from nearby allies when attuning to water.

360.name: Stop, Drop, and Roll
360.description: Dodging removes burning and chilled from nearby allies.

361.name: Powerful Aura
361.description: Any aura you grant yourself is granted to nearby allies.

362.name: Cleansing Water
362.description: Cleanse conditions from allies you grant regeneration to.

363.name: Piercing Shards
363.description: Vulnerability you inflict has increased duration. Deal increased strike damage to vulnerable foes. Damage bonus is doubled while attuned to water.

1502.name: Stormsoul
1502.description:
Deal increased strike damage to disabled or defiant foes. Outgoing stun duration increased.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1503.name: Fresh Air
1503.description: Recharge air attunement on a critical hit. Gain a ferocity boost when attuning to air.

1507.name: Serrated Stones
1507.description: Bleeding you inflict has increased duration. Deal increased damage to bleeding foes.

1508.name: Diamond Skin
1508.description: Remove conditions from yourself when you successfully combo a field with a leap finisher. Remove conditions from nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast finisher.

1510.name: Persisting Flames
1510.description: Fire fields created by weapon skills last longer. Whenever your fire fields hit a foe or you inflict burning, gain increased strike damage for a duration.

1511.name: Bountiful Power
1511.description: Gain charges when changing attunements. Gain a burst of power when you reach the maximum number of charges.

1672.name: Lightning Rod
1672.description:
Cast Lightning Rod when you disable a foe.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1673.name: Elemental Lockdown
1673.description: When you disable a foe, gain a boon based upon your current attunement.

1674.name: Stone Heart
1674.description:
You take reduced strike damage for a duration of time after entering or exiting earth attunement.
Remaining effect duration is lost when exiting.

1675.name: Inferno
1675.description: Burning you inflict scales off of your power instead of your condition damage.

1676.name: Aquamancer's Training
1676.description: Increase healing to other allies. Water-weapon skills gain reduced recharge.

1839.name: Transcendent Tempest
1839.description: Time to attain singularity is reduced. Upon successfully completing an overload, gain increased damage.

1886.name: Unstable Conduit
1886.description: <c=@abilitytype>Overloads</c> grant an aura based on your attunement.

1891.name: Tempestuous Aria
1891.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>shout</c> grants allies might. Granting an aura to an ally increases your outgoing damage for a period of time.

1902.name: Harmonious Conduit
1902.description: Gain stability and swiftness when starting an <c=@abilitytype>overload</c>.

1948.name: Hardy Conduit
1948.description: <c=@abilitytype>Overloads</c> grant protection to nearby allies. Protection gains increased damage reduction.

1952.name: Gale Song
1952.description: Grant protection to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

1962.name: Latent Stamina
1962.description: Grant vigor to nearby allies when attuning to water. Restore endurance to allies you grant vigor.

1986.name: Elemental Bastion
1986.description: Heal allies you grant an aura to. Grant frost aura to nearby allies when struck while below the health threshold.

2004.name: Elemental Enchantment
2004.description: Gain concentration and your attunements gain reduced recharge.

2015.name: Invigorating Torrents
2015.description: Auras you grant also grant regeneration and vigor.

2025.name: Singularity
2025.description: Attain elemental singularity by remaining in an attunement for a period of time. Upon attaining singularity, you may overload the attunement to your vicinity. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Shouts</c>.

2028.name: Soothing Power
2028.description: Gain vitality. Soothing Mist is more effective.

2033.name: Lucid Singularity
2033.description: Apply boons to nearby allies while channeling <c=@abilitytype>overloads</c> and when successfully completing an <c=@abilitytype>overload</c> channel.

2061.name: Swift Revenge
2061.description: <c=@abilitytype>Dual Attacks</c> grant you additional bonuses based on their elements.

2077.name: Elemental Refreshment
2077.description: Gain vitality. Grant barrier to yourself when using Dual Attack skills.

2081.name: Elemental Polyphony
2081.description: Gain attributes based on your current attunement. When dual attuned, gain both benefits.

2090.name: Woven Stride
2090.description: Gain regeneration and cleanse a condition when you grant yourself either swiftness or superspeed.

2109.name: Weaver
2109.description: Your active attunement is now applied to your main hand, with the old attunement moving to your off hand. Attunement recharges are reduced. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Dual Attack</c> and the <c=@abilitytype>Stance</c> utility types.

2115.name: Weaver's Prowess
2115.description: Gain resistance when you attune to a single element.

2131.name: Elements of Rage
2131.description: Gain a bonus to all damage dealt for a period of time when attuned to a single element. Gain access to Unravel.

2138.name: Flow State
2138.description:
Your attunements and Dual Attack skills gain reduced recharge.
This attunement recharge reduction will not take effect while Weave Self is active.

2165.name: Elemental Pursuit
2165.description:
Swiftness on you is improved. Gain swiftness when you disable an enemy.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2170.name: Bolstered Elements
2170.description: Gain protection when activating a <c=@abilitytype>Stance</c>. Activate Lesser Stone Resonance when using an elite skill.

2177.name: Superior Elements
2177.description: <c=@abilitytype>Dual Attack</c> skills weaken enemies. Attacks against weakened foes have increased critical chance.

2224.name: Energized Elements
2224.description: Gain energy and boons when you switch attunements. <c=@reminder>Energy can only be gained while in combat. </c>

2227.name: Depth of Elements
2227.description:
Build up elemental energy when you strike foes. Energy is consumed to imbue the jade sphere with different elements, creating combo fields and granting boons to allies in the area.
Gain access to Augments.

2230.name: Hardened Auras
2230.description: Damage reduction is increased when you grant yourself an aura. <c=@reminder>When this triggers, the durations of all stacks are refreshed. </c>

2231.name: Elemental Epitome
2231.description: Gain an aura based on your current attunement when you combo. Gain Elemental Empowerment when you grant yourself an aura. <c=@reminder>Auras can be gained this way once per attunement per interval.</c>

2233.name: Elemental Synergy
2233.description: Gain a bonus effect when you finish a combo. <c=@reminder>Bonuses can trigger once per attunement per interval.</c>

2234.name: Spectacular Sphere
2234.description: Your <c=@abilitytype>jade sphere</c> is larger and grants quickness and an additional boon based on your current attunement to nearby allies when activated.

2241.name: Empowered Empowerment
2241.description: Elemental Empowerment is more effective. While at maximum stacks of Elemental Empowerment, its effectiveness is increased further.

2247.name: Empowering Auras
2247.description: Gain increased outgoing damage when you grant yourself an aura. <c=@reminder>When this triggers, refresh the duration of all stacks. </c>

2249.name: Evasive Empowerment
2249.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and vigor when evading an attack.

2250.name: Elemental Empowerment
2250.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment while in combat.

2251.name: Sphere Specialist
2251.description: Boons applied by your <c=@abilitytype>jade sphere</c> have increased duration. You can now gain energy while jade spheres are active.

2252.name: Vicious Empowerment
2252.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and might when you disable or immobilize a foe.

2335.name: Galvanic Enchantment
2335.description: After you use a <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> skill, your next strikes create an arc of chain lightning. Chain lightning created by evoker skills inflicts burning.

2344.name: Evocation
2344.description:
Select an element to specialize in, greatly reducing its recharge time and gaining a familiar of that element. The familiar's basic skill charges as you use weapon skills, charging more rapidly when you use a weapon skill of its element. Using the familiar's basic skill three times will enable its empowered skill.
Gain access to meditation skills.

2351.name: Familiar's Prowess
2351.description: Gain a temporary bonus after using a <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> skill.

2354.name: Spirit's Succor
2354.description: Heal yourself when you use a <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> skill.

2380.name: Familiar's Blessing
2380.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you use a <c=@abilitytype>familliar</c> skill.

2382.name: Enhanced Potency
2382.description: Improve a boon based on your familiar.

2391.name: Fiery Might
2391.description: Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

2436.name: Elemental Balance
2436.description: Every second time you enter your selected attunement, the next elementalist weapon skill you use will recharge faster.

2437.name: Specialized Elements
2437.description: You cannot leave your selected attunement. Your familiar's basic skill charges more quickly, and activating it recharges your weapon skills by a small amount. Activating your familiar's empowered skill recharges your weapon skills and triggers traits as if you entered the attunement.

2438.name: Elemental Dynamo
2438.description: Gain one <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> charge when attuning to your selected element.

5487.name: Frozen Burst
5487.description: Detonate a burst of ice that chills nearby foes.

5490.name: Comet
5490.description: Drop a comet of ice on target foe, damaging and dazing foes in the area.

5491.name: Fireball
5491.description: Cast a fireball that explodes on impact and hits multiple foes.

5492.name: Fire Attunement
5492.description: Attune to fire, gaining heavy damage and burning abilities.

5493.name: Water Attunement
5493.description: Attune to water, gaining superior support and healing abilities.

5494.name: Air Attunement
5494.description: Attune to air, gaining heavy damage and control abilities.

5495.name: Earth Attunement
5495.description: Attune to earth, gaining superior damage-over-time and defensive abilities.

5496.name: Drake's Breath
5496.description: Spray a cone of fire at foes while on the move.

5497.name: Flamewall
5497.description: Create a wall of flame at the target area that burns foes.

5500.name: Stone Shards
5500.description: Fling stone daggers at your foe to bleed them.

5501.name: Meteor Shower
5501.description:
Call down a meteor shower onto the target area.
Damage is reduced per target each time they are struck by this ability.

5502.name: Glyph of Lesser Elementals
5502.description: Glyph. Summon a lesser elemental based on your attunement.

5503.name: Signet of Restoration
5503.description:
Signet Passive: Grants health every time you cast a spell. 
Signet Active: Heal yourself.

5506.name: Glyph of Elemental Power
5506.description: Glyph. Unleash elemental energy around yourself. Its effect will differ based on your attunement.

5507.name: Ether Renewal
5507.description: Cantrip. Cure a condition and heal yourself with every pulse.

5510.name: Water Trident
5510.description: Cast a water trident that damages foes. Deal more damage to chilled foes and heal for each target struck. Heal for a lesser amount for each target struck beyond the first.

5515.name: Frozen Ground
5515.description: Coat the target area in ice, chilling foes that enter it. Grant frost aura to allies in the area.

5516.name: Conjure Fiery Greatsword
5516.description: Conjure. Manifest a fiery greatsword in your hands and at the target location. When it lands, it damages and burns foes. Wielders of this weapon gain increased power and condition damage and cast Lesser Fiery Eruption at regular intervals on random enemies.

5518.name: Chain Lightning
5518.description: Hit multiple foes with arcs of chain lightning.

5519.name: Stoning
5519.description: Hurl a rock and weaken your foe.

5520.name: Frost Aura
5520.description: Protect yourself with frost armor that reduces incoming damage by 10%. While active, it chills foes that hit you. Each attacker can be affected by this only once per second.

5521.name: Obsidian Flesh
5521.description: Envelop yourself in stony armor, making yourself invulnerable.

5522.name: Churning Earth
5522.description: Leap at your foe and unleash a seismic wave that inflicts damages and bleeding.

5525.name: Ring of Earth
5525.description: Use the earth to launch yourself into the air and strike foes in a small radius. Deliver a larger ring of earthen spikes upon impact.

5526.name: Arc Lightning
5526.description: Cast an arc of electricity at your foe.

5527.name: Shocking Aura
5527.description: Envelop yourself with electrical energy that stuns nearby foes if they attack you. Each attacker can be affected by this only once every 2 seconds.

5528.name: Eruption
5528.description: Shake the ground until it erupts and damages foes.

5529.name: Ride the Lightning
5529.description: Ride the lightning to your foe, then strike all nearby foes with an electrical burst. If a foe is hit by the burst, the skill's recharge is halved.

5530.name: Swirling Winds
5530.description: Create a swirling wind that blocks projectiles.

5534.name: Tornado
5534.description: Cantrip. Gain stability and shape-shift into a tornado that damages and launches foes.

5535.name: Cleansing Fire
5535.description: Cantrip. Cure conditions and burn foes. Gain might for each condition removed.

5537.name: Cone of Cold
5537.description: Spray an icy blast in a cone that damages foes and heals allies.

5538.name: Shatterstone
5538.description: Cast a shatterstone that will explode at the target area.

5539.name: Arcane Blast
5539.description: Arcane. Blast your foe with energy for critical damage.

5540.name: Conjure Flame Axe
5540.description: Conjure. Manifest a lava axe in your hands and at the target location. Wielders of the weapon gain increased power and condition damage.

5542.name: Signet of Fire
5542.description:
Signet Passive: Improves critical chance.
Signet Active: Burn your target and nearby foes.

5546.name: Conjure Earth Shield
5546.description: Conjure. Manifest a magnetic shield in your hands and at the target location. Wielders of the weapon gain increased toughness and vitality.

5548.name: Lava Font
5548.description: Make lava erupt from the target area.

5549.name: Water Blast
5549.description: Spray a jet of water at your foe that splashes to heal nearby allies.

5550.name: Ice Spike
5550.description: Drop a giant ice spike on foes to make them vulnerable.

5551.name: Healing Rain
5551.description: Call down a healing rain on the target area, granting regeneration to allies and curing conditions once every three seconds. Allies are healed for each condition removed.

5552.name: Lightning Surge
5552.description: Charge a lightning surge that damages and blinds foes near your target when it discharges.

5553.name: Gust
5553.description: Push foes backward with a burst of air.

5554.name: Mist Form
5554.description: Cantrip. Morph into an invulnerable, vaporous mist for a brief time.

5555.name: Magnetic Wave
5555.description: Damage foes, cure three of your conditions, and reflect projectiles with a magnetic surge.

5556.name: Freezing Gust
5556.description: Chill your foe for a brief time.

5557.name: Fire Grab
5557.description: Damage foes in a cone in front of you. Deal more damage to burning foes.

5558.name: Cleansing Wave
5558.description: Heal yourself and nearby allies, curing conditions.

5559.name: Earthen Rush
5559.description: Quickly dash along the ground, summoning spikes along the way and then delivering an area strike.

5562.name: Gale
5562.description: Knock down your foe with a charged wind blast.

5566.name: Steam
5566.description: Blind your foe with superheated water.

5567.name: Conjure Frost Bow
5567.description: Conjure. Manifest a frost bow in your hands and at the target location. Wielders of this weapon gain increased condition duration and healing power.

5569.name: Glyph of Elemental Harmony
5569.description: Glyph. Heal yourself and gain a boon based on your attunement.

5570.name: Signet of Water
5570.description:
Signet Passive: Reduces incoming condition duration.
Signet Active: Damage and chill foes while healing and reviving allies in an area.

5571.name: Signet of Earth
5571.description:
Signet Passive: Reduce incoming strike damage.
Signet Active: Immobilize and bleed your foe.

5572.name: Signet of Air
5572.description:
Signet Passive: Grants a 25% increase in movement speed.
Signet Active: Blind your target and nearby foes.

5573.name: Glyph of Renewal
5573.description: Glyph. Revive allies with different attunement effects.

5597.name: Boil
5597.description: Boil the water around your foe.

5598.name: Magma Orb
5598.description: Shoot a blob of molten rock that explodes after a delay.

5599.name: Lava Chains
5599.description: Cripple multiple foes with lava chains.

5600.name: Heat Wave
5600.description: Launch three waves of heat. Each burns foes and grants vigor to allies.

5605.name: Ice Globe
5605.description: Shoots a slow-moving orb that detonates upon impact.

5606.name: Ice Wall
5606.description: Create a wall of ice that shatters when touched by enemies or when it expires, dealing heavy damage and chilling foes.

5607.name: Tidal Wave
5607.description: Charge forward with tidal force, damaging foes and healing allies.

5624.name: Conjure Lightning Hammer
5624.description: Conjure. Manifest a lightning hammer in your hands and at the target location. Wielders of this weapon gain increased precision and ferocity.

5635.name: Arcane Echo
5635.description: Arcane. The next weapon skill you use has significantly reduced recharge, and this skill's recharge is increased by the original recharge of the affected skill.

5638.name: Arcane Wave
5638.description: Arcane. Blast foes in the target area with an energy wave for critical damage.

5639.name: Armor of Earth
5639.description: Cantrip. Protect yourself with earth armor and gain protection and stability, then gain barrier for each unique boon you have.

5641.name: Arcane Shield
5641.description: Arcane. Block attacks with an energy shield. If it blocks three attacks, it explodes for critical damage.

5644.name: Burning Speed
5644.description: Slide forward and blast the area, leaving behind a line of fire that burns foes.

5646.name: Convergence
5646.description: Charge the air to shock foes around you after a short delay. Inflict weakness on enemies and gain fury for each foe struck.

5648.name: Air Bubble
5648.description: Trap your foe in an air bubble and make them float to the surface.

5650.name: Lightning Cage
5650.description: Create an electrical field that stuns foes crossing it.

5652.name: Air Pocket
5652.description: Release a slow-moving, detonatable air pocket. When it explodes, you teleport to that location.

5653.name: Vacuum
5653.description: Detonate your air pocket to teleport to its location.

5655.name: Electrocute
5655.description: Charge the water around your foe with electricity. Enemies currently using an ability are dazed.

5656.name: Forked Lightning
5656.description: Fire three bolts of lightning in an arc in front of you.

5657.name: Rock Blade
5657.description: Shoot three rocky blades at your foe.

5658.name: Rock Spray
5658.description: Spray a cone of gravel to bleed foes.

5659.name: Rock Anchor
5659.description: Anchor a rock to your foe, making them sink.

5661.name: Murky Water
5661.description: Cloud the water to blind your target and nearby foes.

5662.name: Magnetic Current
5662.description: Launch a large magnetic force that reflects projectiles along its path, crippling foes that touch it.

5666.name: Glyph of Elementals
5666.description: Glyph. Summon an elemental based on your attunement.

5671.name: Static Field
5671.description: Create an electrical field that stuns foes crossing it.

5675.name: Phoenix
5675.description: Release a fiery phoenix that attacks foes in a line before exploding and returning to you, curing a condition and granting you vigor. Inflict additional burning against foes that are already burning.

5678.name: Fire Shield
5678.description: Envelop yourself in a fiery shield that burns foes and grants might each time you are struck (cooldown of 1 second per attacker).

5679.name: Flame Burst
5679.description: Burn foes at the target location.

5680.name: Burning Retreat
5680.description: Quickly roll backward, leaving behind a line of fire that burns.

5681.name: Geyser
5681.description: Create a geyser to heal nearby allies.

5682.name: Windborne Speed
5682.description: You and nearby allies gain swiftness, while curing crippled, immobilized, and chilled.

5683.name: Unsteady Ground
5683.description: Create unsteady ground that foes cannot cross.

5686.name: Shock Wave
5686.description: Create a shock wave that bleeds and immobilizes your target.

5687.name: Updraft
5687.description: Gain swiftness from a gust of wind that launches nearby foes.

5690.name: Earthquake
5690.description: Trigger a quake at your location, knocking down foes and dealing massive damage.

5691.name: Ring of Fire
5691.description: Damage nearby foes with a ring of fire, burning foes that pass through it.

5692.name: Dragon's Tooth
5692.description: Drop an explosive dragon's tooth on your foe.

5693.name: Ice Shards
5693.description: Fire three ice shards at your foe.

5694.name: Blinding Flash
5694.description: Blind your foes with a flash of light. Vulnerable foes are also weakened.

5695.name: Rock Barrier
5695.description: Envelop yourself in a stony barrier that improves toughness.

5696.name: Dust Devil
5696.description: Create a dust storm that inflicts cripple to bleeding foes. The first strike of the storm blinds foes.

5734.name: Glyph of Storms
5734.description: Glyph. Create a storm based on your attunement.

5748.name: Undercurrent
5748.description: Release a current of water to damage foes and regenerate allies.

5780.name: Hurl
5780.description: Hurl the rocks from your barrier at your foe.

5782.name: Geyser
5782.description: Create a geyser to heal nearby allies.

5793.name: Cleansing Wave
5793.description: Heal yourself and nearby allies, curing a condition.

5795.name: Shock Wave
5795.description: Create a shock wave that bleeds and cripples nearby foes.

13334.name: Flame Expulsion
13334.description: After a short delay, release a torrent of flame. Allies are granted might, while damage and burning is increased based on might on you.

15716.name: Vapor Blade
15716.description: Cast a vapor blade that inflicts vulnerability and returns to you.

15717.name: Impale
15717.description: Spear your foes on a giant stone spike.

15718.name: Dragon's Claw
15718.description: Fling fire in a claw-shaped spread at your foe.

21656.name: Arcane Brilliance
21656.description: Arcane. Blast the area, hitting foes with critical damage and healing yourself. Healing effectiveness is increased per target hit. If this skill finishes a combo, you heal an additional amount.

22521.name: Lesser Cleansing Fire
22521.description: Cantrip. Cure conditions and burn foes. Gain might for each condition removed.

24305.name: Lightning Rod
24305.description: Call down lightning on a disabled foe.

25579.name: Lesser Arcane Shield
25579.description: Arcane. Block attacks with an energy shield. If it blocks three attacks, it explodes.

29415.name: Overload Water
29415.description:
Overload. Create a surge of accumulated water magic, healing and cleansing allies. When the cast ends, heal the area and apply regeneration.
Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

29453.name: Sand Squall
29453.description: Apply protection to you and your allies, then increase the duration of all boons currently existing on you and your allies. Gain magnetic aura.

29533.name: Wildfire
29533.description: Release a fiery torrent that burns enemies.

29535.name: "Wash the Pain Away!"
29535.description: Shout. Mists billow from you, healing allies in range and cleansing conditions.

29548.name: Heat Sync
29548.description: Give might and fury to yourself, then spread boons you have to allies.

29618.name: Overload Earth
29618.description:
Overload. Ride your stored earth magic around, granting protection to other allies you move over and crippling enemies, then deliver a final immobilizing blast of power to the area, leaving behind a dust cyclone that delivers the same effects as the overload.
Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

29706.name: Overload Fire
29706.description:
Overload. Unleash your flames, granting might to allies and burning enemies. Finishing the cast creates a tornado that continues to grant might and burn foes.
Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

29719.name: Overload Air
29719.description:
Overload. Use your air magic to summon a nimbus that repeatedly strikes nearby enemies. When this ability is complete, imbue your allies with electricity and create a lingering static region that strikes enemies at the same interval.
Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

29948.name: "Flash-Freeze!"
29948.description: Shout. Unleash a torrent of ice on enemy locations, chilling those who cannot escape. Grant frost aura to allies in range.

29968.name: "Rebound!"
29968.description: Shout. Shout and infuse your allies with arcane energy. Allies who would take lethal damage while this is active ignore the deathblow and are healed instead. If the effect expires naturally, grant an aura based on your current attunement.

30008.name: Cyclone
30008.description: Blast out a cyclone that pulls enemies toward its location and grants swiftness to allies it affects.

30047.name: "Eye of the Storm!"
30047.description: Shout. Imbue your voice with the element of air, massively increasing speed and breaking stun for nearby allies.

30336.name: Dust Storm
30336.description: Grant boons to nearby allies and summon a dust storm that inflicts conditions.

30432.name: "Aftershock!"
30432.description: Shout. Call upon the earth to cripple and immobilize foes in the area around you. Allies in the initial blast gain a magnetic aura.

30446.name: Water Globe
30446.description: Blast out a watery orb that heals allies as it travels.

30662.name: "Feel the Burn!"
30662.description: Shout. Heat waves blast out from the player, causing damage and granting fire aura to allies.

30795.name: Lightning Orb
30795.description: Launch an orb of lightning that fires projectiles at nearby foes.

30864.name: Tidal Surge
30864.description: Send out a tidal wave that regenerates and heal allies, then knocks enemies back.

39964.name: Fire Strike
39964.description: Build elemental flames into your sword and strike your enemies.

39981.name: Sodden Swath
39981.description: Launch a twisting earthen vortex at your enemies.

40139.name: Rust Frenzy
40139.description: Strike your enemies with deadly force.

40170.name: Natural Frenzy
40170.description: Dual Attack. Unleash a volley of ice and earth at your enemies.

40183.name: Primordial Stance
40183.description: Stance. Channel the prime elements at their core, dealing damage based on your current attunements. Fully attuning deals the same condition twice.

40326.name: Fire Swipe
40326.description: Heat your sword a second time and strike your enemies for increased damage.

40332.name: Pressure Blast
40332.description: Dual Attack. Send out a vaporous projectile that violently explodes if it hits the ground or strikes an enemy, healing allies and damaging foes in the area. Heal yourself if you strike an enemy.

40378.name: Hydrothermal Vent
40378.description: Create a thermal vent around your target.

40709.name: Earthen Vortex
40709.description: Burrow into the ground, then erupt with earth-shattering force.

40794.name: Earthen Synergy
40794.description: Dual Attack. Smite your enemies with the earth and sky, dealing damage from below and then stunning from above.

40963.name: Grinding Stones
40963.description: Dual Attack. Shred foes with a storm of stones. Take reduced damage while the storm is active.

41001.name: Elemental Compression
41001.description: Inflict the area around your target with the immense pressures of the earth and sea.

41052.name: Seiche
41052.description: Imbue your blade with water, healing yourself for each target you strike.

41125.name: Plasma Blast
41125.description: Dual Attack. Launch a ball of plasma that explodes on impact at your foes.

41167.name: Aqua Siphon
41167.description: Strike an enemy and draw water from them, causing them to deliver a healing burst to your allies.

41184.name: Monsoon
41184.description: Dual Attack. Launch a hurricane in a direction, knocking enemies back and making them vulnerable.

41712.name: Plasmic Strike
41712.description: Quickly heat the area around your enemy, melting defenses.

42181.name: Fiery Frost
42181.description: Dual Attack. Launch a fire-and-ice bolt while evading and removing movement-impairing conditions.

42271.name: Twin Strike
42271.description: Dual Attack. Quickly strike enemies in front of you with the extreme nature of fire and water.

42321.name: Pile Driver
42321.description: Dual Attack. After a short channel, launch a hyper-fast boulder that decimates foes in its path.

42330.name: Steam Surge
42330.description: Dual Attack. Slide to an area, blasting foes with steam while healing nearby allies.

42379.name: Ashen Blast
42379.description: Dual Attack. Blind your foes with burning ashes.

42867.name: Shearing Edge
42867.description: Dual Attack. Form a frozen blade and spin it toward your enemies.

42913.name: Lesser Stone Resonance
42913.description: Stance. Enter an earthen state, gaining barrier periodically over the course of the stance.

42954.name: Fracturing Strike
42954.description: Dual Attack. Call a meteor from the sky that crashes to the ground, creating an eruption of magma.

43074.name: Pyro Vortex
43074.description: Dual Attack. Strike enemies in an arc in front of you, creating burning vortexes on enemies you hit.

43080.name: Crystalline Strike
43080.description: Attack enemies with a second vicious attack.

43199.name: Breaking Wave
43199.description: Strike your enemies and unleash a wave that heals allies.

43576.name: Plasma Beam
43576.description: Dual Attack. Fire a superheated jet of plasma at your foe.

43616.name: Crystal Slash
43616.description: Strike your opponent with your serrated blade.

43638.name: Weave Self
43638.description: Stance. Temporarily reduce the recharge time of attunements while gaining bonuses for attuning to new elements. Successfully attuning to all elements ends this stance and grants Perfect Weave.

43657.name: Searing Slash
43657.description: Heat your sword a final time and use the full power of your flames to sear enemies and ignite them.

43762.name: Pyroclastic Blast
43762.description: Dual Attack. Launch a molten rock that devastates an area.

43803.name: Quantum Strike
43803.description: Strike your foe, charging them with static and causing lightning to strike repeatedly for a short period of time.

44239.name: Aquatic Stance
44239.description: Stance. Flow like water, gaining endurance. While this stance is active, restore some endurance when you dodge.

44405.name: Riptide
44405.description: Use the element of water to propel yourself backward and regenerate, leaving a healing area at your location.

44451.name: Cauterizing Strike
44451.description: Stab your foe with full force, dealing bonus damage against burning enemies.

44550.name: Lahar
44550.description: Dual Attack. Create an area that cripples and damages enemies. The first pulse of this skill immobilizes enemies.

44612.name: Fervent Stance
44612.description: Stance. Gain quickness, fury, and swiftness. Gain might when you use a Dual Attack.

44637.name: Tailored Victory
44637.description: Release all of your woven elements and end your Weave Self stance, causing gravity itself to unravel around you.

44652.name: Plasma Burst
44652.description: Dual Attack. Burn your foes within a plasma blast.

44681.name: Charged Strike
44681.description: Strike your foe with shocking force.

44926.name: Stone Resonance
44926.description: Stance. Enter an earthen state, gaining barrier periodically over the course of the stance. While the stance is active, protection on you is more effective.

44998.name: Polaric Leap
44998.description: Shadowstep to your target and deliver a dazing strike. Gain superspeed if you interrupt an enemy.

45216.name: Call Lightning
45216.description: Deliver the final attack, calling lightning strikes onto enemies.

45259.name: Polaric Slash
45259.description: Deliver a second strike, gaining swiftness.

45313.name: Flame Uprising
45313.description: Jump forward and deliver a fiery blast to the area.

45983.name: Clapotis
45983.description: Deliver a second strike that heals yourself for each target it hits.

46018.name: Mud Slide

62910.description: Slam your hammer into the ground, damaging nearby enemies. If this strikes a burning enemy, gain offensive boons.

62925.name: Singeing Strike
62925.description: Singe your foes by unleashing a burst of flame from your hammer.

62940.name: Deploy Jade Sphere
62940.description: Summon your jade sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies in its radius based on its element.

62947.name: Wind Storm

62948.name: Crashing Font

62949.name: Fire Sphere
62949.description: Throw your sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies within range based on your active attunement.

62958.description: Strike your foes repeatedly. Enemies hit by all strikes become chilled.

62965.name: Relentless Fire
62965.description: Augment. Your attacks and conditions deal increased damage, and your attacks are unblockable. If this is cast within range of your Fire Sphere, the duration is increased.

62975.name: Rocky Loop
62975.description: Summon a projectile of earth that circles around you, damaging foes. While this projectile is active, you take reduced damage from strikes. Summoning a circular projectile refreshes the duration of all other circular projectiles.

62976.name: Whirling Stones
62976.description: Encase your hammer with earthen spikes to deliver a powerful blow.

62982.name: Invigorating Air
62982.description: Augment. Gain increased endurance regeneration and superspeed. If this is cast within range of your Air Sphere, the recharge time is reduced.

62992.name: Immutable Stone
62992.description: Block the next incoming attack. If you block an attack, gain barrier and an aura based on your current attunement.

63396.description: Summon your jade sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies in its radius based on its element.

69164.description: Dual Attack. Summon projectiles of fire and earth that circle around you, striking enemies they pass through. While the fire projectile is active, it grants you increased outgoing damage. While the earth projectile is active, you take reduced damage from strikes. Summoning a circular projectile refreshes the duration of all other circular projectiles.

69184.description: Dual Attack. Summon projectiles of fire and ice that circle around you, striking enemies they pass through. While the fire projectile is active, it grants you increased outgoing damage. While the ice projectile is active, you take reduced damage from conditions. Summoning a circular projectile refreshes the duration of all other circular projectiles.

Summoning a circular projectile refreshes the duration of all other circular projectiles.

71828.name: Raging Ricochet
71828.description:
Conjure a bullet that bounces to nearby enemies. Gain might for each target struck.

If you have a fire bullet, consume it to gain additional might. If not, create a fire bullet.

71842.name: Boulder Blast
71842.description:
Launch a large boulder that bleeds and immobilizes your foe.

If you have an earth bullet, consume it to gain barrier when striking an enemy. If not, create an earth bullet.

71857.name: Aerial Agility
71857.description:
Dash then fire a quick shot. If the shot hits, you can dash again for a short time.

If you have an air bullet, consume it to remove inhibiting conditions at the start of the dash. If not, create an air bullet.

71863.name: Frostfire Flurry
71863.description:
Dual Attack. Fire multiple bullets of fire and ice, inflicting conditions.

If you have a fire bullet, consume it to gain fire aura. If you have an ice bullet, consume it to cause the ice shots to inflict additional conditions.

71893.name: Piercing Pebble
71893.description: Bleed your foe with sharp stone.

71898.name: Purblinding Plasma
71898.description:
Dual Attack. Fire a ball of plasma that explodes when it hits, striking enemies behind the target.

If you have a fire bullet, consume it to create an area of fire beneath the initial target. If you have an air bullet, consume it to reduce the cooldown of this skill.

71904.name: Electric Exposure
71904.description: Electrify your enemy, making them vulnerable.

71929.name: Scorching Shot
71929.description: Burn your foe with a blazing bullet.

71935.name: Frozen Fusillade
71935.description:
Fire a shot that freezes the ground underneath it, creating an area that speeds up allies while slowing enemy movement.

If you have an ice bullet, consume it to cause the frozen ground to shatter when it expires. If not, create an ice bullet.

71940.name: Searing Salvo
71940.description:
Fire a shot that explodes into fragments of fire when it hits the ground.

If you have a fire bullet, consume it to gain a fire aura. If not, create a fire bullet.

71960.name: Flowing Finesse
71960.description:
Dual Attack. Evade backward and grant yourself boons.

If you have an ice bullet, consume it to gain frost aura. If you have an air bullet, consume it to gain superspeed.

71966.name: Dazing Discharge
71966.description:
Fire a shot that dazes your foe and leaves them vulnerable. 

If you have an air bullet, consume it to reduce the cooldown of your next pistol skill. If not, create an air bullet.

71993.name: Molten Meteor
71993.description:
Dual Attack. Bombard your foe with a meteor that inflicts multiple conditions.

If you have a fire bullet, consume it to cause the shot to explode when it strikes an enemy, damaging other foes in the blast. If you have an earth bullet, consume it to inflict additional bleeding.

72023.name: Enervating Earth
72023.description:
Dual Attack. Fire a quick shot that debilitates your target. 

If you have an air bullet, consume it to also inflict daze. If you have an earth bullet, consume it to also inflict bleeding on your target.

72028.name: Frigid Flurry
72028.description:
Fire a volley of icy bullets that inflict bleeding.

If you have an ice bullet, consume it to heal for each strike. If not, create an ice bullet.

72032.name: Shattering Stone
72032.description:
Fire a shot that shatters into multiple shards.

If you have an earth bullet, consume it to enhance your next few attacks to inflict bleeding. If not, create an earth bullet.

72033.name: Soothing Splash
72033.description: Shoot a bullet of water. Heal for each unique condition on the enemy.

72062.name: Echoing Erosion
72062.description:
Dual Attack. Bleed your foe with ice and stone.

If you have an ice bullet, consume it to heal yourself. If you have an earth bullet, consume it to grant yourself barrier.
